## [2026.2] - 2026-11-13
### Added
- If opened in a location other than `/Applications`, Beekeeper offers to move itself to the Applications folder, where it can update itself. - A job's snapshot list shows how much its snapshots share, so the sizes add up to the total.
### Fixed
- Beekeeper can connect to a Hive at a Tailscale address.

## [2026.1] - 2026-11-12
The first release of Hive, which backs up your servers from a Mac, and Beekeeper, which manages it.
### Added
- Hive runs in the background from startup with its keys in the Secure Enclave. - Incremental snapshots of server directories over rsync and SSH, browsable in Finder. - MySQL, MariaDB and Postgres dumps, on the host or in Docker containers. - Schedules, retention by day and month, and per-server quotas. - Live progress, a job log and an audit log in Beekeeper. - Email alerts for failed backups, a missing drive, changed host keys and low space. - Pairing with a QR code or pairing code. Every connection is TLS, pinned to the Hive's key. - A recovery key and encrypted recovery files, for bringing Hive back on a new Mac. - Updates for both apps. Beekeeper shows when Hive needs an update.
